tasks.subject: Task 1: Relocate RenderCx + region helpers out of widget.rs
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Move RenderCx, region_metadata, is_valid_region_name to permanent homes and repoint all imports, leaving widget.rs holding only the Widget trait. Build stays green; Widget + impls keep working.

**Files:** component.rs (add RenderCx), render.rs (region helpers + tests as mod region_tests), widget.rs (only Widget trait), lib.rs (re-export region_metadata), components/{calendar_view,notice,stepper,checkbox,highlight_text}.rs + runtime.rs (repoint), apps/reading-queue/src/lib.rs (RenderCx path), harness recording.rs + tests/simulator.rs (region_metadata -> crate root).

**Verify:** cargo test --workspace

```json:metadata
{"files": ["crates/inkapp-core/src/component.rs", "crates/inkapp-core/src/render.rs", "crates/inkapp-core/src/widget.rs", "crates/inkapp-core/src/lib.rs", "crates/inkapp-core/src/runtime.rs", "crates/inkapp-core/src/components/calendar_view.rs", "crates/inkapp-core/src/components/notice.rs", "crates/inkapp-core/src/components/stepper.rs", "crates/inkapp-core/src/components/checkbox.rs", "crates/inkapp-core/src/components/highlight_text.rs", "apps/reading-queue/src/lib.rs", "crates/inkapp-harness/src/recording.rs", "crates/inkapp-harness/tests/simulator.rs"], "verifyCommand": "cargo test --workspace", "acceptanceCriteria": ["RenderCx in component.rs; region helpers+tests in render.rs", "widget.rs holds only the Widget trait", "region_metadata re-exported at crate root", "no crate::widget imports of the 3 moved items", "Widget still defined + implemented unchanged"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Delete the Widget trait; collapse component impls to inherent read
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Remove the Widget trait, its module, and all 3 impl Widget blocks, replacing each with one render path + an inherent read; fix the trait-form callers. Atomic core of the refactor — one commit.

**Files:** components/checkbox.rs, components/stepper.rs, components/highlight_text.rs, lib.rs (remove pub mod widget), DELETE widget.rs, apps/reading-queue/src/lib.rs, harness tests/{e2e,exercisers}.rs.

**Verify:** cargo test --workspace; grep -rn 'trait Widget|impl Widget|use .*::Widget|Widget::render|dyn Widget|pub mod widget' crates apps -> no matches.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["crates/inkapp-core/src/components/checkbox.rs", "crates/inkapp-core/src/components/stepper.rs", "crates/inkapp-core/src/components/highlight_text.rs", "crates/inkapp-core/src/lib.rs", "crates/inkapp-core/src/widget.rs", "apps/reading-queue/src/lib.rs", "crates/inkapp-harness/tests/e2e.rs", "crates/inkapp-harness/tests/exercisers.rs"], "verifyCommand": "cargo test --workspace", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Widget trait gone; widget.rs deleted; pub mod widget removed", "3 components each have one render path + inherent read", "no impl Widget / use ::Widget / Widget::render remains", "all pre-existing .read() callers pass unchanged, no assertion weakened"]}
```
